title: How to Upgrade Your Handbag Style This Fall

body_markdown:
The best fall purse doesn't have to carry your entire life from September until Christmas. This season, smaller silhouettes, tactile materials, and playful finishing touches make a strong case for carrying only what you need, and making every detail count.


Think polished leather with denim. Soft corduroy against a crisp jacket. A silk scarf knotted around a handle. A tiny bear hanging from a bag that otherwise means business. When it comes to handbag styling, there's no single formula. Pick the shape, texture, and extras that feel like you, then make them your own.


## Clara Convertible Shoulder Bag: Your Outfit's Very Capable Plus-One


Our[Clara Convertible Shoulder Bag in leather](https://verabradley.com/products/clara-convertible-shoulder-bag-5565724376) has that polished, pulled-together look that plays especially well with fall layers. Its clean silhouette makes it an easy match for everything from wide-leg denim and loafers to a midi skirt and tall boots.


And because the adjustable strap is removable, you can change how the bag sits with your look. Carry it closer to the shoulder when you want a classic profile, or add the longer strap when your outfit calls for a different proportion. Inside, a zip pocket keeps smaller essentials together without overcomplicating things.


Pair it with the[Small Deluxe Tab Wallet in leather](https://verabradley.com/products/small-deluxe-tab-wallet-5586320089) for an equally streamlined companion. At just 4 ¼" wide, it keeps your ID, cards, and cash organized in a compact shape that leaves plenty of room for the rest of your essentials.


**How we'd style it:** When it comes to styling a leather purse for fall, choose tonal neutrals, a favorite knit and one unexpected accent like patterned shoes, statement earrings, or a silk scarf. Polished does not have to mean predictable.


## Mini Clara in Corduroy: Texture Is the Outfit


The[Mini Clara purse in corduroy](https://verabradley.com/products/mini-clara-5588724255) taps into one of fall's great pleasures: texture. Its curved silhouette feels modern, while corduroy adds a little touch of softness and nostalgia to the mix.


At 9" wide, it stays firmly in small-bag territory, with two interior credit card slips that make it easier to travel light. The compact proportions also make it a natural match for fall's more substantial pieces like oversized outerwear, chunky sweaters, or relaxed denim, without competing with them.


**How we'd style it:** Let the corduroy do the talking. Pair a[corduroy purse](https://verabradley.com/collections/corduroy?productListFilters=categories%3AShoulder%20Bags&productListPgNo=1) with smoother fabrics like denim, wool, or leather to create contrast.


## Small Original Vera Tote: A Classic Rethought


Some classics don't need reinventing. They just need the proportions tweaked.


The[Small Original Vera Tote in full-grain leather](https://verabradley.com/products/small-original-vera-tote-5525220142) brings the familiar Original Vera Tote shape into a more compact silhouette. The leather gives it a refined fall feel, while the exterior slip pocket and six interior slip pockets make organization easy without turning the bag into a filing cabinet.


With an 11 ½" square body and a wider 16 ¼" top, it has enough presence to anchor an outfit while still feeling lighter and more streamlined than a larger tote.


Prefer pattern and quilting? The Small Original Vera Tote is also available in classic[premium cotton with a quilted cotton lining](https://verabradley.com/products/small-original-vera-tote-5525824251) , giving you another way to interpret the same iconic silhouette.


**How we'd style it:** Use a[leather tote](https://verabradley.com/collections/leather?productListFilters=categories%3ATote%20Bags&productListPgNo=1) as a grounding piece with prints and layered color, or let a[soft quilted cotton tote](https://verabradley.com/collections/premium-cotton?productListFilters=categories%3ATote%20Bags&productListPgNo=1) become the focal point of a simpler look. Your bag doesn't have to match.


## Maisie Handbag in Denim: Denim Does Dress Up


The[denim Maisie Handbag](https://verabradley.com/products/maisie-handbag-5621524383) is proof that classics have all the fun.


Its compact 8" wide silhouette has a clean, timeless shape, but denim gives it a more relaxed point of view. That combination makes it especially easy to style for fall, when wardrobes naturally start mixing structured pieces with softer, more casual layers. Finish with two small exterior slip pockets to keep frequently reached-for items close, while the zip closure keeps the silhouette neat.


**How we'd style it:** That old rule about not mixing denim? Consider this your permission slip to ignore it. Pair a[denim purse](https://verabradley.com/collections/denim?productListFilters=categories%3AShoulder%20Bags&productListPgNo=1) with[corduroy](https://verabradley.com/collections/corduroy) . Add a[denim crossbody](https://verabradley.com/products/harwick-large-messenger-5632824375) to a trench. Carry a[patchwork denim tote bag](https://verabradley.com/products/original-vera-tote-5632924375) with a dress and boots. Or try denim-on-denim if that's your thing!


## Original 100 Handbag: The One That Started Something


There are throwbacks, and then there are originals.


The[quilted cotton Original 100 Handbag](https://verabradley.com/products/original-100-handbag-5406020089) brings back the silhouette that helped start the Vera Bradley story, thoughtfully crafted for the way we carry now. It features three exterior slip pockets, five interior slip pockets, and a soft quilted cotton lining, balancing recognizable Vera Bradley design with plenty of everyday function.


**How we'd style it:** For fall, the Original 100's classic shape gives you room to[play with pattern](https://verabradley.com/products/original-100-handbag-5406020089) . Pair it with solid separates, mix it with another print or take the maximalist route and keep going.


## Amanda Shoulder Bag: Add New Shape to the Rotation


The[Amanda Shoulder Bag in premium quilted cotton](https://verabradley.com/products/amanda-shoulder-bag-5586620089) has a slim, vertical silhouette that adds a different proportion to fall looks. It's stylishly spacious without feeling oversized, with an exterior slip pocket, two interior slip pockets, and an interior zip pocket.


And there's another texture joining the story: the Amanda Shoulder Bag will also be available in Velvet later in the fall, just in time for your holiday celebration. Because once the calendar starts filling up, a little velvet makes a very good argument for itself.


**How we'd style it:** Pair it with straight-leg jeans and a sweater, a long coat and boots, or whatever combination is currently winning the bedroom-chair audition.


## How to Style a Handbag Without Overthinking It


Wondering how to style your handbag so it feels more personal? Start with the part that has absolutely nothing to do with rules: choose something you like.


Then add another thing you like!


That's where[scarves](https://verabradley.com/collections/scarves) and[bag charms](https://verabradley.com/collections/keychains-and-charms) come in. They're an easy way to change the attitude of a favorite handbag from one outfit or one day to the next.


### Square Silk Scarf: Tie It Up


The[Square Silk Scarf](https://verabradley.com/products/square-silk-scarf-5058924252) is printed silk in a versatile 25 ½" square, giving you plenty of ways to make it part of your look.


Knot it around a handbag handle. Tie it into a loose bow. Wrap it around your neck and let the bag stay simple. Style it in your hair. There isn't a test later.


A silk scarf also creates a particularly interesting contrast against rich materials like leather, denim, and corduroy. Smooth meets textured. Polished meets playful. Everybody wins.


### Bag Charms: Your Handbag Has Hobbies Now


Bag charms have a way of turning a handbag into your handbag. They add color, movement, texture, and, occasionally, a tiny bear, all of which seem important.


The[Original Tote Bag Charm](https://verabradley.com/products/original-tote-bag-charm-5103124251) takes an instantly recognizable tote silhouette and shrinks it down to a playful accessory, complete with classic quilted cotton and a zip closure. Consider it a Vera Bradley tote for your Vera Bradley tote!


For something a little softer, the adorable[Bitty Bear Bag Charm](https://verabradley.com/products/bitty-bear-bag-charm-5011622546) brings personality to handbags, totes, and keys alike. Available in[premium cotton](https://verabradley.com/collections/premium-cotton?productListFilters=categories%3AKeychains%20%26%20Charms&productListPgNo=1) and[corduroy](https://verabradley.com/collections/corduroy?productListFilters=categories%3AKeychains%20%26%20Charms&productListPgNo=1) , it's an especially fun way to bring another fall texture into your look.


Want something that gets noticed? The[Beaded Bird Bag Charm](https://verabradley.com/products/beaded-bird-bag-charm-5603524445) adds a decorative, conversation-starting detail with an easy-to-attach hinge ring.


The[Bird Earbud Bag Charm](https://verabradley.com/products/bird-earbud-bag-charm-5628624375) proves a charming accessory can have a job, too. Its zippered design accommodates most earbuds, while the patchwork style makes it an easy companion for the season's casual looks. Your earbuds have officially moved into a nicer apartment.


And for a floral moment that isn't remotely concerned with the temperature outside, the[Floral Bag Charm](https://verabradley.com/products/floral-bag-charm-5534023457) brings a pop of color and movement with its elongated faux-leather design.


## This Fall, Follow Your Own Bag Rules


Leather or corduroy. Denim or soft cotton. Compact shoulder bag or small tote. One charm or enough charms to require introductions.


The right fall fashion handbag is the one that works with your style. Start with a silhouette you're drawn to, play with the season's richer materials, then add scarves, charms, and other details until it feels unmistakably yours.
